name: FloraWuMusic Studio

reviews.text: Mrs. Flora Wu is a very great teacher. I observed how she teaches students and had a conversation with one of her students. She is full of patient and enthusiasm when she teaches students. Most her students had very good performance in the piano contest. Mrs. Flora cooperates with parents closely to keep the kids on the right track and get improved. I decided to enroll my son to Mrs. Flora's class when my son is ready.
reviews.author: Annie Peng

reviews.text: I really love Mrs.Flora's classes. She is truly the best piano teacher around.
reviews.author: Evan Wu

reviews.text:
Ms. Flora Ye has been an exceptional piano teacher for my daughters, and we feel very fortunate to have found her. My older one learned with Ms. Ye for 12 years. She brings not only a high level of musical expertise, but also a thoughtful and inspiring approach to teaching that truly resonates with students.
What stands out most is Ms. Ye’s ability to balance technical rigor with genuine encouragement. She sets high standards while creating a supportive environment where my daughter feels motivated to learn. Her lessons are structured yet engaging, and she has a remarkable talent for tailoring her teaching style to the individual needs and personality of each student.
Ms. Ye genuinely cares about her students for their growth and development. Her friendship, encouragement, and inspiration will always be with my daughters.
reviews.author: Luo Wenqin
